researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official inventory and GPX/API baseline. HÖ19 GPX has 801 trackpoints, one segment, 19.988762 km, start 57.50100/14.46514, end 57.53825/14.27461, two intervals over 100 m but none over 150 m, one duplicate point, HÖ18-HÖ19 gap 5.712 m, HÖ19-HÖ20 gap 1.262 m and direct GPX available while .kml/.geojson/.json variants were unavailable.

No second targeted batch was needed because the remaining issues are import/normalization caveats: weak Tomtabacken transit, Hok station connector modeling, stop-coordinate verification, shelter/currentness checks, water caveats, nearby reserve scoping, dynamic fire status and Storm Dave currentness.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ19 has navigation-grade official GPX/API v2 geometry, strong endpoint continuity with HÖ18 and HÖ20, high-confidence official endpoints at Tomtabacken and Hok/Hook herrgård, sufficient six-lane research coverage, and no direct protected-area overlap found. Main caveats are weak Tomtabacken transit, inferred Hok Hooks herrgård bus-stop coordinate, Hok station connector distance/geometry, endpoint/shared facility deduplication, medium-confidence shelter/currentness records, no confirmed public potable water between endpoints, commercial-service access caveats, dynamic fire-ban status and Storm Dave windthrow currentness.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Tomtabacken, the route leaves Småland's high-point area and follows forest and lake country west toward Hok and Hooks herrgård. The section has long stretches without confirmed public water or convenient transit at the start, but the Hok end offers stronger access via the official station connector plus services around Hook/Hok. Treat shelters and natural water with caution until currentness is verified, and always check fire-ban and windthrow notices before hiking.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Höglandsleden research with HÖ20 Hok-Byarum. Do not normalize or import runtime data until the full research phase is reviewed and import is explicitly requested.
